children: UK life sciences firm's H1 revenue rose 22% yr/yr, driven by growth in Asia and Europe
Gross profit climbed 25%, with margin improving to 55.9% from 54.4%
Company reduced selling and R&D costs, narrowing operating loss from prior year
Company expects further cost reductions in H2 2026 from lower manufacturing and absence of one-off costs
OptiBiotix prioritises commercialisation of SweetBiotix, targeting initial product samples around end-2026
Company sees growing commercial interest in SweetBiotix and an expanding international customer pipeline
ASIAN SALES GROWTH - Strong sales in Asia and 'Rest of World' markets, particularly a 133% increase in Asia, offset weaker performance in the US and India
COST REDUCTIONS - Lower selling, R&D and patent costs, including a 69.5% drop in selling costs, supported margin improvement and reduced operating loss
AI-DRIVEN MARKETING - Introduction of AI tools for Amazon marketing increased return on spend to 3.6X from 1.2X, improving marketing efficiency and boosting organic sales
Sept 15 - UK's ValiRx half-year loss narrows, cash position improves
Sept 15 - UK's ImmuPharma interim net loss widens on derivative finance loss
